app.title: RTSP Camera Manager
app.subtitle: Add camera instances to Home Assistant using only the stream URL

camera.name: Name
camera.name_hint: Shown in Home Assistant, for example Front door
camera.enabled_hint: Disabled cameras are hidden from Home Assistant but stay saved here.
camera.test_ad_hoc_hint: You can test the URL before saving the camera.
camera.empty_text: Paste an RTSP URL, test the stream, then save it. Every camera you save here becomes a camera entity in Home Assistant.
camera.ha_stream_url_hint: Used by the camera entity instead of the URL above, for example the H.264 sub stream of an H.265 camera.
camera.ha_codec_warning: This camera sends {codec}. Home Assistant camera cards only play H.265 in a few browsers - use the H.264 sub stream above when the picture stays black.
camera.preview_save_first: Save the camera first to use the live preview

preview.title: Preview: {name}
preview.hint: The preview runs ffmpeg inside the add-on and stops as soon as you close this window.

integration.title: Home Assistant integration
integration.description: The add-on writes every camera into a JSON file and installs a small integration that turns each entry into a camera entity you can put on any dashboard.
integration.restart_required: Restart Home Assistant to load the integration
integration.restarted: Home Assistant received the restart request
integration.disabled: Automatic installation is disabled in the add-on options
integration.file_note: The integration reads every camera from {path}

settings.title: Add-on settings
settings.language_note: The interface follows the language of Home Assistant. Pick a language here to override it for this browser.
settings.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg is missing in this container, tests and previews are unavailable
settings.cameras_file_error: The camera file could not be written: {path}

help.title: How it works
help.step1_text: Give it a name and paste the RTSP URL exactly as you would in VLC. Credentials may be part of the URL.
help.step2_text: Use “Test stream” for the codec, resolution and frame rate, and “Quick preview” for a live look before saving.
help.step3_text: The integration creates one camera entity per instance, so you can place it on any dashboard or use it in automations.
help.step4_text: Renaming, disabling or deleting a camera here is picked up by Home Assistant within seconds, no YAML needed.
help.security_text: The web interface is only reachable through the authenticated Home Assistant ingress, and passwords inside stream URLs are masked in the list and in the log.
